publicationBasis.note: Database snapshot is cumulative. Its latest official Date of Entry is not represented as a Federal Register publication date; all record-level list IDs and entry dates are preserved.

fullRawSisArchive.reason: All 1738 exact downloaded HTML records remain in the hashed 19MB local archive; repository evidence preserves all per-record source URLs, response statuses, byte counts/hashes plus representative exact HTML. Runtime uses only the fully normalized dataset.

normalizationPolicy: Require complete HTTP200 acquisition for all IDs in the unfiltered official browser export, exact byte/hash match, and all recognition identities matched exactly once.

Primary designation/title comes from the identity-matched SIS primary Standard block. CSV removes commas and some title quote marks; preserve SIS punctuation and keep all official CSV designation aliases.
Only parse literal FDA Product Code cells; evaluate actual column spans so explicit codes in shorter rows remain captured. No inference from regulation, device title or subject matter.
Preserve uncoded CFR citation/blank rows and per-record publishedAssociationStatus. Empty productCodes means the complete source publishes no explicit code association.
Reject the whole candidate for any HTTP, identity, date, HTML structure, column or required-field failure. Never install a partial dataset.
Preserve the source association-section text for all 279 unmapped records with such a section; broad FDA scope declarations do not become guessed literal product-code associations.
